cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad and the puppy Max outdoors. Landscapes are wide and bright; compass words show a compass rose with one point glowing.

words.en: The air is fresh in the mountains.
words.scene: Lily on a hilltop with her arms wide open, taking a deep breath of fresh air, her hair blowing, little swirls of breeze around her.
more: Open the window and let in some air.

words.en: The leaves are red and brown in autumn.
words.sz: 秋天的树叶是红色和棕色的。
words.scene: An autumn park with orange, red and brown trees, leaves falling, Tom jumping into a big pile of leaves.
more: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

words.en: We play on the beach in summer.
words.scene: A sunny sandy beach with blue sea, a striped umbrella, a bucket and spade, and a sandcastle.
more: The beach is very busy today.
Max loves running on the beach.

words.en: A bee is on the flower.
more: Look! A bee is flying near the flowers.
看！一只蜜蜂在花旁边飞。

words.en: France is a beautiful country.
words.sz: 法国是一个美丽的国家。
words.scene: A big friendly globe with a few countries highlighted in bright colours, small flags of different countries pinned on it.
more: Which country do you come from?
We go to the country at the weekend.
senses: We go to the country at the weekend.

words.en: Grandpa lives in the countryside.
words.scene: Beautiful green countryside with rolling fields, sheep, a little farmhouse, a winding lane and hills in the distance.
more: We walk in the countryside on Sunday.
我们星期天在乡间散步。

words.en: It's very hot in the desert.
words.scene: A golden sand desert with tall dunes under a blazing sun, a small green cactus and a line of camels far away.
more: There is no water in the desert.

words.en: The sun comes up in the east.
words.scene: A wooden signpost in a field with one big arrow-shaped sign pointing to the right, a big letter E painted on the arrow, the morning sun rising on the right.
more: They live in the east of the country.
他们住在这个国家的东部。

words.en: The explorer walks into the forest.
words.scene: A brave grown-up explorer with a hat, a backpack, a map and binoculars walking through a green jungle, a colourful parrot watching.
more: I want to be an explorer.
The explorer finds a new island.
探险家发现了一座新岛。

words.en: There are cows in the field.
words.scene: A wide green field with a wooden fence, a few cows eating grass and a tree in the middle under a blue sky.
more: The children play in the field.
This field is full of flowers.

words.en: We sit by the fire in winter.
words.scene: A cosy campfire at night with orange flames and sparks, a family sitting around it on logs.

words.en: Lily picks a flower for Mum.
words.sz: Lily 给妈妈摘了一朵花。
words.scene: One big beautiful pink flower with a yellow middle and green leaves.
more: There are lots of flowers in the garden.

words.en: Bears live in the forest.
words.scene: A deep green forest of tall pine trees with sunlight shining through, a path and a deer among the trees.
more: The forest is dark at night.

words.en: The cow is eating grass.
words.scene: Close-up of fresh green grass with a few daisies and a ladybird climbing a blade of grass.
more: The grass is wet in the morning.

words.en: Plants grow in the sun.
words.scene: Three pots in a row showing a sunflower growing: a seed, a small shoot, then a tall flower, Tom watering it.

words.en: We walk up the hill.
words.scene: A round green hill with a single tree on top, Lily and Max running up the path.
more: There's a castle on the hill.

words.en: It's very hot in summer.
more: Be careful! The soup is hot.
It's too hot to play football.

words.en: Put some ice in my juice, please.
words.sz: 请在我的果汁里加点冰。
more: There is ice on the lake.
Can I have some ice in my cola?

words.en: There's a small island in the lake.
words.scene: A small round tropical island with palm trees and a sandy beach in the middle of a blue sea.
more: We go to the island by boat.

words.en: We swim in the lake in summer.
words.scene: A calm blue lake surrounded by trees and mountains, a small rowing boat and ducks on the water.
more: There are ducks on the lake.

words.en: The moon is bright tonight.
words.scene: A big bright full moon in a dark blue night sky with twinkling stars, over sleepy hills.

words.en: There's snow on the mountain.
words.scene: A tall mountain with a snowy top, pine trees at the bottom and a little hut, under a blue sky.

words.en: It's cold in the north.
words.scene: A simple round wooden compass seen from above with the letters N at the top, S at the bottom, W on the left and E on the right, one big red arrow pointing straight up to the N, a little polar bear and snow at the top edge.
more: It snows a lot in the north.
Go north to find the lake.
往北走就能找到那个湖。

words.en: Water the plant every day.
words.scene: One green plant with big leaves in a terracotta pot on a sunny windowsill.

words.en: There are fish in the river.
words.scene: A winding blue river through green fields with a little wooden bridge and fish jumping.

words.en: The sea is blue today.
words.scene: The wide blue sea with gentle waves, a sailing boat in the distance and seagulls in the sky.

words.en: The sky is blue and clear.
words.scene: A huge clear blue sky with a few fluffy clouds and birds flying, a tiny field at the bottom.
more: There are no clouds in the sky.
Look at the birds in the sky.

words.en: Birds fly south in autumn.
words.scene: A simple round wooden compass seen from above with the letters N at the top, S at the bottom, W on the left and E on the right, one big red arrow pointing straight down to the S, a little palm tree and sun at the bottom edge.
more: They live in the south of England.

words.en: There are many stars in space.
words.scene: A friendly rocket flying through space with stars, a ringed planet and the Earth in the background.
more: I want to go to space.
There's no space in my bag.
senses: There's no space in my bag.

words.en: Flowers come out in spring.
words.scene: A spring garden with fresh green leaves, tulips and blossom on the trees, baby birds in a nest.

words.en: I can see a star in the sky.
words.sz: 我能看见天上有一颗星星。
words.scene: A dark blue night sky with one big bright yellow five-pointed star in the middle and many small twinkling stars, no moon, sleeping hills below.
more: There are lots of stars tonight.
She is a famous film star.
她是一位著名的电影明星。
senses: She is a famous film star.

words.en: We go to the beach in summer.
words.scene: A bright summer day: a sunny beach with children playing, ice creams and a big yellow sun.

words.en: There's a bird in the tree.
words.scene: One big leafy green tree with a strong brown trunk, a bird's nest in its branches.

words.en: Drink some water. It's hot today.
words.scene: A clear glass of water with a few drops splashing, next to a jug of water.

words.en: The sun goes down in the west.
words.scene: A wooden signpost in a field with one big arrow-shaped sign pointing to the left, a big letter W painted on the arrow, an orange sunset on the left.
more: They live in the west of the country.
他们住在这个国家的西部。
They drive west to the sea.

words.en: It snows in winter.
words.scene: A snowy winter village with white roofs, a snowman, children sledging and smoke rising from chimneys.
more: We wear warm clothes in winter.
冬天我们穿暖和的衣服。

words.en: The table is made of wood.
words.scene: A neat pile of chopped wooden logs with rings visible on their ends, next to a small axe.
more: Dad puts more wood on the fire.
爸爸往火里加了些木柴。
We walk in the wood near our house.
我们在家附近的树林里散步。
senses: We walk in the wood near our house.

words.en: This jumper is made of wool.
words.scene: Balls of colourful wool with knitting needles, and a fluffy sheep beside them.
more: 我们从绵羊身上得到羊毛。
Grandma has a lot of wool.

words.en: There are many countries in the world.
words.scene: The planet Earth seen from space, blue oceans and green continents, children holding hands in a circle around it.
more: I want to travel around the world.
This is the biggest tree in the world.
